action: close at the first positive-volume close within 5 min after the alert minute (notebook 15), reopen after 240 min
alerts: M0 calendar alarms (notebook 5), as in paper section 10

position.liquidation_check: minute lows over the 240 minutes after entry

reading_rule: At leverage k the alert stream is said to pay if the 95% lower bound of the mean value per alert after a 5-bp fee is > 0 and the observed mean exceeds the regime-matched null (p < 0.05). Reported for every k; no k is selected.
title: Value of acting on M0 alerts for leveraged long holders (dev 2023-01..2026-04, exploratory)
uncertainty: calendar-month block bootstrap, 2000 draws, 95% interval of the mean value per alert
value: percent of margin avoided: -(holding P&L), holding P&L = -100 if liquidated else 100*k*(simple 240-min return); fees [0, 5] bp one-way on notional, both legs; funding and slippage ignored
